content.title: Miniature Escape | Giant Pursuit to Resupply
content.summary: Use one giant moving object to calibrate the miniature scale, then keep the same character on a continuous route through progressively different movement verbs—running, bouncing, climbing, and balancing—until the character reaches and uses a resource.

quick_start.input_format: Miniature subject + massive moving pressure + 3 types of material action verbs + continuous path + obtaining and using resources
quick_start.recommended_input: The palm-high origami surveyor escapes from the rolling cleaning brush, jumps on the elastic measuring tape, climbs the wooden spool, balances on the steel ruler, and finally obtains and activates the battery bead.
required_anchors: Calibrate the miniature scale using a single ordinary oversized moving force in the opening.
Change the movement verb at each material transition.
Maintain one consistent travel direction and subject identity across scale changes.
End with a resource that the subject visibly secures or uses.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: First use a giant object to calibrate the miniature scale, and then let the same character continuously change actions such as running, bouncing, climbing, and balancing, and finally reach the available resources.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: Make scale readable immediately by placing a miniature subject beside one ordinary oversized force, then convert pursuit into a route of three materially different terrain actions. Each surface must change the subject's movement verb—run, spring, climb, balance or reach—and the final resource must be earned by the route rather than presented as a decorative giant object.

invariants.rule: Calibrate miniature scale with one ordinary oversized moving force in the opening.
invariants.purpose: Makes size and threat readable without explanation.
invariants.ablation_failure: A tiny subject alone has no reliable scale.

invariants.rule: Change the movement verb at every material handoff.
invariants.ablation_failure: Continuous running through new backgrounds becomes a chase montage.

invariants.rule: Use at least three surfaces with visibly different physical responses.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated rigid platforms add no new problem-solving.

invariants.rule: Preserve one travel direction and subject identity across scale changes.
invariants.ablation_failure: Discontinuous geography turns actions into unrelated vignettes.

invariants.rule: End with an earned resource that the subject visibly secures or uses.
invariants.purpose: Gives the traversal a purpose beyond survival.
invariants.ablation_failure: A decorative giant object is not a payoff.

slots.name: lead_subject
slots.constraint: An original stable subject or pair with a readable role.

slots.name: setting
slots.constraint: A new setting with fixed spatial anchors and no source-specific surface.

slots.name: escalation_variable
slots.constraint: One causal variable that changes through visible stages.

slots.name: performance_rule
slots.constraint: A restrained acting or motion rule that keeps the mechanism legible.

slots.name: camera_grammar
slots.constraint: An information order that proves each state without copying source shot boundaries.

slots.name: payoff
slots.constraint: A clean final physical, informational or social consequence.

slots.name: sound_family
slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

anti_copy_exclusions: source backyard garden route and eating payoff
